79420.body:
Weekly FinTech Digest

Автор: Linas Beliūnas


Автор: Linas Beliūnas

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/95-bank-ai-pilots-fail-because-chatbots-cant-run-meta-linas-beli%C5%ABnas-ukhcf?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BUfan4MFoRZaFDUk2YEzdYQ%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=1s1s-zDZiwcss1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mu9l9t0p~82-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mu9l9t0p-82
  
👋 Hey, Linas here! Welcome to a 🔓 weekly free edition 🔓 of my daily newsletter. Each day, I focus on 3 stories that are making a difference in the financial technology space. Coupled with things worth watching & most important money movements, it’s the only newsletter you need for all things when Finance meets Tech. If you’re not a subscriber, here’s what you missed last week: The Agentic Transition Playbook 🧠 [How founders and builders win when software starts building itself] How to Use GPT-6 Astra, the OpenAI Model Jensen Huang Called AGI 🤖 [8 GPT-6 Astra workflows, copy-ready prompts, and practical settings for founders, builders, investors, and entrepreneurs who want to build products, research investments, and get more value from AI] The Ultimate Guide to Grok Bot: The First Real AI Agent OS 🤖 [The complete guide to building a persistent AI agent operating system with Grok Bot — setup, working prompts, 8 end-to-end workflows, multi-agent teams, security, and the economics of AI teammates] GLM-5.3-Flash: Local AI Goes Multimodal 🤖 [Why the first open multimodal AI model that rivals Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.6, runs on a single Mac, and was served without NVIDIA chips resets the math for founders, builders, and investors] The Age of the One-Person Company 🦄 [What the latest data reveals about solo founders building million-dollar companies with AI agents instead of employees, and where the next big opportunity is in 2026] The New Enterprise AI Go-To-Market Playbook 📚 [The a16z framework that decides which AI startups win the enterprise, and how founders can use it in 2026] Meta Muse bets the AI Agent race against Grok Bot and Gemini will be won on Trust 🤖🛡️ [why Meta's trust problem forced the best safety design any consumer agent has shipped, why Muse, Grok Bot and ChatGPT all spend through the same Stripe Link wallet, & what to watch for next + bonus deep dives into the Ultimate Guide to Grok Bot, and Anthropic’s Strategy to Win Agentic Commerce inside] Chime buys Stride Bank for $590 million and promises not to grow it 🤔🏦 [why the $10B Durbin cap, not the charter, is the real deal, why Bancorp fell 14% in a day while Chime’s own sponsor bill goes to zero, & what to watch next for Revolut, SoFi and every sponsor bank with one dominant client + bonus guide into how to Turn Claude AI Into a Financial Analyst
